name: App Set ID
plain: A resettable per-developer ID on Android, not for ads.
meaning: Links installs of one developer's apps for analytics and fraud with no prompt and no ad use. Resets after 13 months idle.

android.note: Scope APP or DEVELOPER; resets after 13 months of inactivity

limits.headline: Can recognise your Android phone across one developer's apps, not for ads
limits.user_action: Nothing. It happens when the app starts
can: Link installs from the same developer for analytics and fraud checks
Keep the same ID across reinstalls while another app from that developer stays
cannot: Follow you into other companies' apps
Stay the same after 13 months of no use
Work on iPhone; IDFV is similar there
limits.differs: Android only. iPhone has IDFV, which does the same job.

story.what_it_is: A resettable Android ID for one developer's apps, meant for analytics and fraud, not ads.

marketing.name: App Set ID
marketing.pitch: A reset, per developer ID for analytics and fraud prevention, with no ad use allowed.

story.for_you: You never see it. It lets one company know that two of its apps are on the same phone, so a trial or a limit applies once.
story.for_makers: It needs no prompt and cannot be used for ad targeting. It links installs of one developer's apps for analytics and fraud, and it resets after 13 months idle.

use_cases.example: A studio with several games gives a one time welcome gift per phone across all of them.
A fraud team sees one phone register 30 fake accounts across its apps and blocks it.
A company with a main app and a lite app counts one user instead of two.
A store avoids sending the same coupon twice.
A developer groups crash reports by device across apps.

story.android_note: Android only, and it resets after 13 months without use.
